events.text: RED FLAG round — two LAWS ruled by the user, both violated today: (HH) MODAL DISCIPLINE: an unresolved confirm/session gates EVERYTHING. Image 58 = Create Paint Atlas dialog opened ON TOP of a live loop-cut session; user can also switch to paint mode, add cubes, or edit the mesh mid-session. Mechanics: ModelView's lc session state only listens to Esc; the mode row/toolbar/atlas flow (createAtlasAndPaint) never check lc != null; AppFrame's hotkey gate checks openMenu/newMeshPrompt/fileExplorer/buildDialog but NOT the loop-cut session or ModelView-local dialogs. The lc session holds a captured base mesh host-side while other ops mutate the live mesh — stacked unresolved state, undefined interactions. LAW: while a session/dialog awaits resolution, every other surface is inert (or opening X auto-resolves/cancels Y explicitly). (II) CONTROL-GRID DISCIPLINE ('bartering for UI space'): Image 57 loop-cut popup edge — close/stepper/Apply controls on no shared axis (per-control ad hoc padding 8 vs 9, popup can sit clipped at screen edge, Apply cut off); Image 59/60 MODEL FOCUS paint-variants card — 'Update Painting 1' wraps to two lines inside a chip, PAINT VARIANTS header wraps, controls crammed against + New, rows compress below content. LAW: dialogs/panels lay controls on a shared column grid (steppers in fixed-width columns, one right edge, one baseline per row), button labels never wrap, popups clamp fully on-screen, rows reserve their space instead of squeezing. These are ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA folded into every theme T1-T5, not a separate polish-later bucket — user: 'not that a feature half ass landed but that the basics of how you build a ui went out the left field'.

LANDED HH+II for the flagged surfaces (81309f7b0 + e2a4d1158): blocking predicate lifts lc-session/atlas-prompt/import dialogs through one gate — commandEnabled grays with 'resolve X first', runCommand refuses loudly, hotkeys/menus/mode-row/dock/outliner guarded, Esc resolves innermost first; verified headlessly (key:1/key:p inert during lc session). Loop-cut popup on fixed 26/64/26 column grid, bottom-center 8px-inset clamp; atlas-dialog-under-wireframe z-order FIXED via scissor-segment isolation (capsules flush after rects within a segment — overflow:hidden starts a fresh segment). Control grid now also enforced across focus panel (region agent).
